summary: Board members vote on whether a company’s substitute for the requested review meets the same safety goal.
realLife: Cenovus hired a specialist to check manuals at facilities without an overall technology licensor. After receiving the report, the Chemical Safety Board accepted that approach and closed its recommendation.
gates: The company has submitted evidence of its alternative.
inGame: needs: an open safety recommendation and a board disposition on substitute evidence.

turns.what: The board sends the company's substitute review back for more work.
turns.pulledBy: The review leaves one facility outside its scope.
turns.writesBack: The recommendation stays open with the missing facility identified.

turns.what: The board closes the recommendation for the facilities the review covers.
turns.pulledBy: The report documents checks at only some sites.
turns.writesBack: The remaining sites stay under review.
